necessary_adapters: Go2 UDP reader bound to existing secondary address 192.168.123.99; local TCP middleware without sysctl changes
Receive-only state conversion of existing Unitree LowState/SportModeState; no sport request, joy, cmd_vel endpoints
NX receive-time stamping because hardware sport clock differs by ~1774 seconds
Planar odom/base_footprint decomposition; fixed lidar transform owned only by URDF/RSP
Node startup staggered and discovery avoids self peers and redundant bidirectional initial peer connections
slam_choice: 2D slam_toolbox is minimal Foxy-compatible first working mapping path using XT16 projected scans and existing dog odometry. h-naderi RTABMap ICP is a future 3D alternative, requires dependencies; CMU PointLIO defaults require calibrated L1 IMU/data formats and include motion interfaces, not a drop-in XT16 solution. No custom SLAM implementation.
limits: Physical yaw/translation calibration is baseline reuse, not precision calibration
Static initial map; traversal/loop closure not tested
Go2 sport error_code 1001 passed through without interpretation
No robot movement; Nav2 cmd_vel isolated as /nav2/cmd_vel_preview with no Unitree bridge
Remote desktop RViz rendering slower than sensor stream; initial known RViz shader warning does not prevent displayed map
